fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. The LORD says, "Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills." So the claim that they've forgotten is false, because the text says they remember. The children aren't forgetting a thing, and I think that's what makes this verse so heavy.

Egypt is a famous place for slavery, baker (Exodus 1:13–14), but this verse never says it. The LORD says, "I will enslave you to your enemies in a land that you do not know…" He doesn't name the land here. He says it's one they don't know.
